args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades the fastjson pin from 2.8.0 to 3.1.0 to fix CVE-2026-31337 (high severity: unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays).

## Notes
- CVE-2026-31337 affects fastjson <2.9.4 and >=3.0.0 <3.1.0; 3.1.0 is the fixed release.
- The 3.1.0 version was chosen per the reviewer's direction, since the team completed the fastjson 3.x migration last sprint (a 2.9.4 bump was initially proposed and redirected).
- CI passed on this branch (run ci-0001, sha 13fee7191e).

## Changes
- `requirements.txt`: `fastjson==2.8.0` → `fastjson==3.1.0`
